data.name: Nivaan
data.long_meaning: The name Nivaan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Niv' which means 'to rest' and 'An' meaning 'against'. The name symbolizes a person who has overcome all obstacles and has reached a state of rest or peace. It is a name for those who have progressed in life and have attained success and stability.
